purpose: Documents whose speaker-unassigned passages may be associated with one person at query time (--attribution author). Every returned passage carries basis and caution. Corpus labels are never rewritten.

review_notes.document-author: Wesco letters 1983-1996: metadata attribution_notes record a visible sole Charles T. Munger signature on each. Berkshire 1970-1976 letters and the 1984 Superinvestors essay: Buffett-authored per document metadata.
review_notes.meeting-notes-principal: Wesco annual meetings 1999-2010, 2011 Pasadena conversation, Daily Journal 2013-2015 notes: Munger chaired/was the principal speaker; notes are third-party paraphrase and interleave questions and note-taker remarks. 2026-10-10: added four student Q&A note sets with Buffett (Kansas 2005-05, Berkshire HQ 2005-10, Emory/UT 2008-02, Ivey 2015-02); each read before adding.
review_notes.archive-attributed: 1984 draft op-ed and 2010 'Basically, It's Over': the Worldly Munger archive attributes them to Munger; the copies carry no byline.
review_notes.excluded: Blue Chip Stamps letters (co-signed), 1965-1969 Chace letters, biographies, Singleton 2022 (unattributed two-person dialogue), CNBC meeting unlabelled passages, 2014 mixed letter.
review_notes.translation-of-own-words: 2026-10-11: chapters of a locally imported Chinese PCA (2016; not distributed with this skill) that render Munger's talks and remarks, Munger's note on Buffett, and Buffett's foreword. Editorial chapters (portrait, approach, articles, reading list) and the Chinese Snowball are not attributed to either person. 2026-10-12: 25 meeting chapters of the user-owned 《芒格之道》 (Wesco 1987–2010, Daily Journal 2014–2022); only unlabelled paragraphs (Munger's remarks) are attributed.
